meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把编码任务放进独立工作区,让多个助手并行推进并互相交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用多个编码助手,想让他们分工又方便交接
copy.tagline_en: Run coding tasks in isolated workspaces and hand them off between assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding assistants and want them to split work and hand off

howto.what: Claude 会先为本次会话选定正确的 Orca 可执行文件,加载与版本匹配的指南,再用 orca 命令操作 Orca 管理的工作树、文件夹上下文、终端、仓库、自动化、产物、技能共享和内置浏览器。
howto.when: 当你提到 “$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”、“handoff” 等关键词时触发;涉及 Orca 状态时优先于裸 git worktree 或临时 PTY。

say.text: $orca-cli,先加载本次会话的 Orca 指南
say.note: 会运行 ORCA skills get orca-cli

say.text: 在这个 Orca 工作树里启动一个 codex
say.note: 会通过 orca 命令派生子工作树

say.text: 读一下 Orca 终端里的输出
say.note: 会读取并等待该终端内容

howto.what_en: Claude picks the Orca executable for this session, loads the version-matched guide, then runs orca commands to work with Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing and the embedded browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" and similar; prefer it over raw git worktree or ad hoc PTYs when Orca state is involved.

say_en.text: $orca-cli, load the Orca guide for this session
Spawn a codex in this Orca worktree
say_en.note: Creates a child worktree via orca

say_en.text: Read the output in the Orca terminal
say_en.note: Reads and waits on that terminal
